effects: The signer's FXRP balance drops by `amount`, which goes to `to` with no fee (OZ ERC20._transfer; FAsset._beforeTokenTransfer only checks balance, blocks sending to yourself and checks the emergency pause).
formats.shown: Send FXRP, with the amount in FXRP (6 decimals) and the recipient address.

findings.title: transfer has no interpolatedIntent, so the intent line leaves out the amount and the recipient.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json transfer: "intent": "Send FXRP", no interpolatedIntent; fields #.amount and #.to are always visible.

effects: Sets the signer's FXRP allowance for `spender` to exactly `amount`, replacing any earlier allowance (OZ ERC20.approve -> FAsset._approve -> ERC20._approve). Only type(uint256).max is never used up (_spendAllowance).
formats.shown: Approve FXRP, with the spender and the amount; values at or above 2^255 show as 'Unlimited FXRP'.

findings.title: approve has no interpolatedIntent, so the intent line leaves out the spender and the amount.

formats.key: transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 amount)
effects: Uses up `amount` of the allowance that `from` gave the signer (msg.sender), unless that allowance is type(uint256).max (ERC20._spendAllowance).
formats.shown: Send FXRP, with the source, the recipient and the amount in FXRP.

findings.title: transferFrom intent 'Send FXRP' does not say the tokens come from another account through the signer's allowance.
findings.evidence: ERC20.sol transferFrom: _spendAllowance(from, spender, amount); _transfer(from, to, amount). descriptor intent "Send FXRP", same as transfer; the From field is shown.
findings.fix: Use the intent "Transfer FXRP from another account" or the interpolatedIntent "Send {amount} from {from} to {to}".

findings.title: transferFrom 'From' addressName types leave out 'contract', though contracts can hold FXRP.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json transferFrom #.from params.types ["eoa","wallet"]; ERC20.transferFrom accepts any holder.

effects: Raises the signer's FXRP allowance for `spender` by `addedValue`, to the current allowance plus addedValue (ERC20.increaseAllowance).
formats.shown: Increase FXRP allowance, with the spender and the added amount in FXRP.

findings.title: increaseAllowance shows only the increase; the new total depends on the stored allowance.
findings.evidence: ERC20.sol increaseAllowance: _approve(owner, spender, allowance(owner, spender) + addedValue); the field '#.addedValue' is labelled 'Amount'.
findings.fix: Rename the label to 'Added amount'. The total cannot be shown from calldata.

effects: Lowers the signer's FXRP allowance for `spender` by `subtractedValue`, and reverts if that would go below zero (ERC20.decreaseAllowance).
formats.shown: Decrease FXRP allowance, with the spender and the amount taken off in FXRP.

findings.title: decreaseAllowance shows only the decrease; the remaining allowance depends on stored state.
findings.evidence: ERC20.sol decreaseAllowance: _approve(owner, spender, currentAllowance - subtractedValue); the field '#.subtractedValue' is labelled 'Amount'.

formats.key: permit(address owner, address spender, uint256 value, uint256 deadline, uint8 v, bytes32 r, bytes32 s)
effects: Sets the allowance that `owner` gives `spender` to `value`, using owner's off-chain signature, if done before `deadline` (ERC20Permit.permit -> _approve).
Uses up owner's next permit nonce (_useNonce).
formats.shown: Permit FXRP, with the owner, the spender, the amount (2^255 or more shows as 'Unlimited') and the deadline date. The signature parts are hidden.

findings.title: The permit intent 'Permit FXRP' is jargon and does not say an allowance is set for the spender.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json permit intent "Permit FXRP", no interpolatedIntent. ERC20Permit.permit ends in _approve(owner, spender, value).
findings.fix: Use the intent "Approve FXRP by signature" and the interpolatedIntent "Let {spender} spend {value} of {owner}'s FXRP until {deadline}".
